title: Cedar Gifts — missing gift-wrap information
type: Original fictional transfer exercise after guided cafe demonstration, not official exam or workshop material
official_source: Topic1 lecture slide4: tool-based perspective provides recipes, techniques and tools to manage change; source verified previously and unchanged.
teacher_made_guidance: problem → action → check; illustrative checklist, not a named official model
facts: Customer message asks for gift-wrap on order305.
Order form has product, quantity and contact phone but no gift-wrap field.
Packing team already knows wrapping and sees the order list, not customer messages.
goal: Make gift-wrap requests visible to packing.
interface: One action click. Original reason before consequence is optional; no reason is invented. Consequence and two short course/learning statements appear after choice.
model_boundaries: Capturing a request only helps if it is actually linked to the packing list. Manual asking adds a task; no real time or business performance quantified. Own plan requires discussion rather than an invented simulated outcome.
assessment: Awaiting own choice. Choice alone is insufficient for mastery; if no original reason is entered ask one meaningful subject question.
validation: All4 actions, no pre-choice consequence, conditional ribbon/ticket state, no-reason play, Russian help, exact pre-consequence reason, fallback, 320px and styled sandbox checked. Screenshot inspected.
